tasks.label: Stop Local Dev Servers
tasks.command: lsof -ti:3002 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; lsof -ti:5173 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; lsof -ti:8080 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -f 'go run ./cmd/worker' 2>/dev/null || true

tasks.label: Check Docker Daemon
tasks.command: docker context use desktop-linux >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo 'Docker daemon not ready.' && exit 1)

tasks.label: Start Analytics Postgres
tasks.command: docker context use desktop-linux >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo 'Docker not ready. Attempting to start Docker Desktop...'; open -a Docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; for i in {1..90}; do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 2; done); docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo 'Docker daemon unavailable. Start Docker Desktop and retry.' && exit 1); cd ${workspaceFolder}/../doyou-music-analytics && docker compose up -d postgres && for i in {1..60}; do docker compose exec -T postgres pg_isready -U doyou >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 2; done; docker compose exec -T postgres pg_isready -U doyou >/dev/null 2>&1 || (echo 'Postgres failed to become ready in time.' && docker compose ps && exit 1)
